mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.required: Your role can see sensitive data, so two-step verification is required before you can use those features.
mfa.explain: Sign-in asks for a code from an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password) as well as your password.
mfa.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the key manually.
mfa.enterCode: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app
mfa.recoveryBody: Each code works once if you lose your phone. They won't be shown again.
mfa.turnedOn: Two-step verification is on. Other sessions were signed out.
